memory_update.text: PLPC should be tracked as the highest-purity underfollowed US-listed candidate for transmission/distribution line hardware; key survival tests are order intake, utility approvals, energy segment growth and evidence that procurement leads contractor activity.
ATKR is a hypothesis candidate for grid hardening and cable-protection adjacency, but it needs product/end-market proof because broad construction exposure could swamp node-specific signals.
AZZ is a second-order materials/process candidate for galvanizing and coating of steel used in T&D infrastructure; verify whether electrical T&D is material within Metal Coatings.
For grid T&D buildout, expand beyond EPC contractors into installed hardware, conduit/cable protection, galvanizing/coatings, substation components, and utility-approved niche suppliers.

summary: Expanded the grid T&D hardware/materials universe with one reference anchor and three underfollowed second-order candidates. The highest-purity underfollowed candidate is PLPC, which maps directly to tower/pole line hardware. ATKR and AZZ are less obvious adjacent chokepoints: conduit/cable protection and metal coating/galvanizing for critical infrastructure. HUBB is included only as a reference leader because it has direct T&D component exposure but is larger and more diversified.
